name: flat-ply4-interim-cold
description: Interim read (11-11 ~02:45) at PLY 4, near argmax (T 0.02): flat-p3 (ply-3 field) and its twin flat-p2 (ply-2 field), final versions, with the best ply-2-trained flat LR and d4mix v426. Question: at ply 3 flat-p3 beat the ply-2-trained LR by 174 and lost 221 at ply 2; does training deeper also win one ply further (the goal), or does it follow the parity of the depth?
